summary: In January 2024 Ortiz co-signed San José's unanimous council ceasefire resolution, and in September 2025 he personally directed the city's Finance Director to report on investment holdings in companies he described as complicit in Israel's genocide in Palestine. CAIR Action lists him as preferred and Vote for Peace rates him an Ally. His campaign platform raises no further foreign-policy positions, and the 2024 statement's both-sides condemnation language stands in tension with the more pointed 2025 directive.
